MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Urology Service Registrar - RAH





Job no: 939841

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Medical




 

Central Adelaide Local Health Network (CALHN)

The Royal Adelaide Hospital 

Salary MDP-2 $99,707 - $158,523 p.a.+ super + salary packaging

Full-time temporary 

Duration of the training program: temporary from 1-2-27 up to 28-1-29

Term of the Contract: 3 Years in line with clause 52 of the Salaried Medical Officers Enterprise Agreement

At the end of the training program, CALHN will work with the employee to find a suitable placement within SA Health for the remainder of the 3 year contract 

Grow Your Medical Career With Us
Join CALHN's exceptional medical team and play a vital role in shaping the future of health through innovation, collaboration and world-class care.

Work across diverse clinical specialties and services

Advance your skills through structured learning and development

Benefit from supportive teams and dedicated non-clinical time

Make a real impact delivering safe and connected compassionate care

Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN

About the Role

As a valued member of the Urology Unit, you will work under the guidance of the Head of Unit and senior consultant staff, gaining hands-on experience and expert support in a collaborative clinical setting. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your clinical knowledge and surgical skills while maintaining active and professional relationships with consultant colleagues.

You'll work within a multidisciplinary team committed to excellence in patient care, education, and innovation. In addition to your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the supervision and teaching of junior doctors and medical students, and have the opportunity to initiate and develop research projects-making a meaningful impact on both patient outcomes and the future of urological practice.

About You

You are a dedicated and professional medical practitioner with a strong foundation in urology and a commitment to delivering high-quality patient care. Your ability to communicate effectively, work collaboratively, and manage clinical responsibilities makes you a valuable addition to any team.

Hold an MBBS or equivalent, with current AHPRA registration

Demonstrated clinical skills in general, open, and endoscopic urological surgery

Strong communication, negotiation, and complaint resolution skills

Sound knowledge of hospital systems, policies, and multidisciplinary care structures

Why You'll Love It Here - CALHN benefits that matter
We know that a great career is about more than just the work you do, it's also about the support you receive. At CALHN, you'll enjoy :

Salary packaging - up to $9,010 for living expenses + $2,650 for meals & entertainment + pre-tax super & novated lease options

Safe connections - be part of a culture of safety and connectivity, focusing on outcomes and continuous improvements

Professional development - funding + study leave for growth opportunities

Recognition & growth - celebrate success and explore opportunities across CALHN's many sites

Flexible work options - speak to us about flexibility options for this role to suit your lifestyle

Paid leave - with leave loading for rest and recharge

Health & fitness perks - discounted access to Fitness Passport & free flu vaccinations

Wellbeing support - Employee Assistance Program for you & your family

Diversity & Inclusion
We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, culturally diverse backgrounds, and LGBTQIA+ communities.

Application Information

Please refer to the role description for essential educational-vocational qualifications that may be required 939841 RD Urology Service Registrar - RAH.pdf

Appointment will be subject to satisfactory Criminal History Clearances and compliant immunisation screening as indicated in the role description.

Job title:  Speech Pathologist - Clinic/Community - Tamworth NSW 

  Working hours:  Full time or part time 

  Salary offer:  Competitive Salary Offer + CPD Allowance + Benefits 

  Location:  Tamworth NSW 

   

  About the company:  

 Our client is a locally owned mobile and in-clinic service based in the rural NSW town of Tamworth. Their multidisciplinary team consists of highly experienced Physiotherapists, Exercise Physiologists, Speech Pathologists and Occupational Therapists. The company prides itself on providing high quality, patient centered, evidence-based practice to manage the complex needs of people across the lifespan with Neurological and/or physical disabilities. Services are delivered through a mixture of home/community appointments (with optional rural outreach days) and in clinic appointments. The clinic is a state of the art facility, equipped with dedicated consult rooms, adult neurorehab/paediatric gym spaces, and a large team room for notes/admin/breaks. They strive for continual improvement, innovation, sustainable practice and clinical excellence. Therefore, they allocate time and resources to professional development, regular team meetings, in-service education, and social events. 

   

  About the role:  

 As the speech pathologist you will be required to assess, diagnose and treat communication disorders, including difficulties with speaking, listening, understanding language, reading, writing, social skills, stuttering and using voice. You will work with people who have difficulty communicating because of developmental delays, stroke, brain injuries, learning disability, intellectual disability, cerebral palsy, dementia and hearing loss, as well as other problems that can affect speech and language. Additionally, you will support people who experience difficulties swallowing food and drink safely and managing their secretions. You will be required to work independently and also as part of a multidisciplinary team to ensure positive client outcomes. Being a mobile service, you will be required to travel to client’s homes and local businesses around Tamworth and its surrounds as well as in-clinic appointments. Due to the extra time that is allocated for travel and admin, you would typically be seeing four to six patients on a regular work day. You have the freedom to inform admin as to the structure of your schedule and work hours, in alignment with the organisations goals. The caseload will be a mixture of NDIS and Lifetime Care clients. Due to the extent of our waitlist, we are able to cater the caseload to the therapists areas of clinical interest and experience. A two week paid on-boarding/ training process will be provided, wherein you will spend time with the practice manager learning the business' software and systems, and attend joint appointments with our speech pathologists. 

   

  Benefits:   

 
	  Flexible Work Schedule:  Designed for long-term job satisfaction and work-life balance. 
	  Unique Service Delivery:  Work in our new Allied Health Center with dedicated consult rooms, purpose built adult neurological and paediatric gym facilities plus your own desk space for notes and admin. For clients    Apply Now
